correctness.rationale: Two independent complete facet constructions agree: 720 filtrations, 30 gap/root facets, 163 augmented faces. Exact mod-two boundary ranks (11,37,30) force rational Betti concentration in dimension 2 of rank 5 by Euler characteristic. Oriented fixed-face traces for every dihedral element are computed from the permutation on incidence labels. Reduced Lefschetz theorem gives the character; r^3 has finite order and trace 5, hence it acts trivially, and the S3 character decomposes exactly. The dependency-free embedded checker replays all finite steps.

value.rationale: The pure strong-Morse complex of a cycle is a new natural topological construction with a canonical graph-symmetry action. For the first equal-dimensional five-sphere case C6, its nonequivariant wedge type cannot distinguish a faithful D6 action from an action factoring through D3. Computing the complete homology character reveals an unexpected nonfaithful half-turn, exact order-three rotation, and a concrete irreducible S3 decomposition. This is a motivated new natural invariant rather than a routine restatement of published Betti numbers. The result remains confined to C6.
